svg.title: ContinuousState, Trajectory and Motion
svg.desc: UML class diagram of the timeline types CHUGG returns: a ContinuousState maps each entity to a Trajectory, a Trajectory is a std::set of Motions ordered by start time, and a Motion pairs an Interval with a location, a footprint, an event id and an optional discrete change.

g.text: Abridged from continuous_state.hpp, trajectory.hpp and interval.hpp; all_motions and MotionScheduleOrder are in scheduler.cpp.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: What CHUGG reads and returns. Each entity has one Trajectory; a Trajectory keeps its Motions sorted by start time and refuses overlaps. The scheduler then merges every trajectory into one set with a full tie-break and builds the action DAG from it.
